Retire the four actor slots, set the wave state and a displaced tick origin, initialize/clear the effects player and enable its sound-mode bit.
When at least ten low ticks have passed, advance the saved message tick and decrement the central message countdown $13C0 if nonzero.
Choose the central portrait/message image, including its timed warning alternation, and copy three rows of eight glyphs and colours into the central status area.
Select downward speed two and jump to the common falling-actor controller.

Calculate screen/colour pointers from the platform's half-step position and authored base offset. Choose one of two twelve-byte glyph/colour frames from its position parity, draw up to four three-cell rows and clip the writes to the playfield.
